name: olio.pb.sceneElement
label: Scene element
description: PictureBook V3 §8 scene element: one non-character thing placed in an olio.pb.composition - a prop, furniture, animal, vehicle, structure or natural feature - with a normalized box (x, y, w, h in 0-1 image space), depth (0 = front), an importance the composer spends prompt budget by, and an optional olio.item FK when the thing is a world item with its own colours and materials. Rows live in the book's group, owned by the request user, and are found by the 'composition' FK - never a list on the composition. Deleted with the book by PbDeleteUtil. No field carries a schema default (PB2 convention rule 3, TestPbModelSchema): enum columns read NULL as UNKNOWN, numbers read 0 on legacy rows.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The thing as the text describes it; the base of its prompt fragment.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Left edge of the element's box, normalized 0-1 of image width.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Top edge of the element's box, normalized 0-1 of image height.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The world item this element is, when it is one; nullable. Its name/description/colours/materials are watched (watched/v4) so an item edit marks the composition's render stale.
